predecessors.name: Moghulistan
predecessors.text: the northern Tarim Basin from Turpan, the eastern division of Moghulistan

ledger.x: 1487: Ahmad Alaq founds the Turpan Khanate.
1503: Mansur Khan becomes khan and holds court at Aksu.
1517: the Ming fight Turpan over Hami.
1528: the last battle with the Ming that the page lists; no treaty is named and the page does not describe a Ming withdrawal from Hami ('Turfan also annexed Hami').

wars.name: Hami campaign of 1513
wars.outcome: Mansur took Kara Del (Hami) in 1513 when its prince changed his allegiance from the Ming to Mansur.

wars.name: Ming–Turpan wars over Hami
wars.outcome: Battles in 1517, 1524 and 1528; Mansur was beaten by the Chinese in 1524 with 20,000 men.

wars.name: Ahmad Alaq against the Shaybanids
wars.outcome: The Turpan page has Ahmad Alaq 'defeated and killed by Muhammad Shaybani' in the early 1500s; the Mansur page says 'both Ahmad and Mahmud were captured' in a failed campaign against the Uzbeks of Transoxiana.

wars.name: Yarkand conquest of Turpan
wars.outcome: Abduraim Sultan of Khotan invaded in 1570, captured Muhammad Khan and brought Turpan under Yarkand control.

certainty.note: Oasis frontiers between the Turpan, Aksu and Hami districts and the Ming guards are approximate; no line is recorded.
